- Gameplay modified for more planet puzzles 
- Improved full screen mode with background graphics
- Junior mode

notes.title: Update note for 1.3.1
notes.notes:
Micropayments are removed
- The micro payments were included to game for players, who might want to speed up the progress of game (i.e. take shortcuts). 
- Due negative feedback, the micro payments are now removed.

Secret Item Collector is available from the start 
- It is now possible to collect items in hyperspace in first level
- You need to buy Extended collector for collecting secret clues

Game starts in easy difficulty level
- The game is quite hard (too hard) in normal level so the default level is changed

Fix to auto-targeting available in the start of tutorial
- This caused a confusion, because players could use auto-targeting before tutorial got there.

Minor bug fixes and improvements
